settings.heading: What we learned this month
settings.body:
Open with the story your readers will care about most. Keep paragraphs short — two or three sentences reads well on a phone.

A second paragraph can add detail, a **key figure**, or a link to read more.

settings.heading: A story from our community
settings.body:
Share something a customer, member or colleague did. People read stories about people.

Finish with a single, clear thought.

settings.text: The best newsletters feel like a letter from someone you know.
settings.author: A happy reader

settings.body: A sentence or two about what's next, so readers look forward to the next issue.
